shortDescription: Manage Linode LKE cluster node pools.

options.name: autoscaler
options.description: When enabled, the number of nodes autoscales within the defined minimum and maximum values.

options.name: cluster_id
options.description: The ID of the LKE cluster that contains this node pool.

options.name: count
options.description: The number of nodes in the Node Pool.

options.name: disk_encryption
options.description: Local disk encryption setting for this LKE node pool.

options.name: disks
options.description: This Node Pool’s custom disk layout. Each item in this array will create a new disk partition for each node in this Node Pool.

options.name: firewall_id
options.description: Firewall ID for the Node Pool.

options.name: k8s_version
options.description: The desired Kubernetes version for this Kubernetes  Node Pool in the format of <major>.<minor>, and the  latest supported patch version. NOTE: Only available for LKE Enterprise to support node pool upgrades.  This field may not currently be available to all users and is under v4beta.

options.name: label
options.description: A unique label for this Node Pool.

options.name: labels
options.description: Key-value pairs added as labels to nodes in the node pool. Labels help classify your nodes and to easily select subsets of objects.

options.name: skip_polling
options.description: If true, the module will not wait for all nodes in the node pool to be ready.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the target.

options.name: tags
options.description: An array of tags applied to this object. Tags must be unique as they are used by the `lke_node_pool` module to uniquely identify node pools.

options.name: taints
options.description: Kubernetes taints to add to node pool nodes. Taints help control how pods are scheduled onto nodes, specifically allowing them to repel certain pods.

options.name: type
options.description: The Linode Type for all of the nodes in the Node Pool. Required if `state` == `present`.

options.name: update_strategy
options.description: Upgrade strategy describes the available upgrade strategies. NOTE: Only available for LKE Enterprise to support node pool upgrades.  This field may not currently be available to all users and is under v4beta.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: The period to wait for the node pool to be ready in seconds.
